title: it2colors settings
description: User settings for the it2colors CLI: named aliases that bundle a base scheme with HSV adjustments, and per-scheme default adjustments.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema; useful for editor validation.

version.description: Settings file format version. Currently always 1.

aliases.description: Named aliases. Each key is invocable on the command line like a base scheme name (e.g. `it2colors my-warm-adventure`).

scheme_defaults.description: Per-scheme HSV defaults applied automatically whenever the named scheme is selected (by name, by -r, or by -c).

adjustment.description: Tuple of HSV-style transforms applied in CIE HCL space. All fields default to no-op values when omitted.

hue.description: Hue rotation in degrees. 0 leaves hue unchanged.

lightness.description: Perceived lightness shift (CIE HCL L). Negative darkens, positive brightens.

saturation.description: Chroma multiplier. 1.0 = no change, 0 = grayscale, >1 boosts. NOTE: an absent field or 0 is treated as 1.0 by the CLI to make hand-editing forgiving.

alias.description: An alias binds a name to (base scheme, HSV adjustment). Invoking the alias applies the base with the adjustment.

base.description: Base scheme name (a .itermcolors filename without extension). Must exist in the schemes directory at apply time.
